versions.changelog:
- Initial release of feed-designs-you-video-gen.
- Generates vertical short videos (5 or 10 seconds by default) with five equal, caption-timed segments critiquing algorithmic feeds.
- Highly stylized visuals: thumb on glass, UI glitch effects, neon/dark mode, bold outlined captions in lower third.
- Supports custom wording per segment (five windows required by default), CLI video generation, and both text-to-video and image-to-video modes.
- Requires WERYAI API key, Node.js 18+, and compatible with KLING_V3_0_PRO/STA and SEEDANCE_2_0 models.
- Designed for critiques of algorithm control, feed manipulation, and doomscrolling—no factual platform internals or individual targeting.
